name: button
summary: Native action, submit, or link with typed label, variant, size, state, and optional decorative icon.

agent.useWhen: In a Native app template, declare <cui-button kind="submit" label="Save" /> inside an app-owned command form. Use kind="action" for app-owned browser behavior or kind="link" with a safe href or named route for navigation. Choose variant, size, icon, and optional busy/disabled states without copying component HTML or CSS.
agent.avoidWhen: Use a separate form contract for fields; a submit button alone does not authorize or bind a command.

invariants: Configuration selects kind, appearance, icon and literal destination; labels and checked busy/disabled page bindings are app-owned presentation inputs.
The component owns no Datastar signals or persistent state. Output is a native button activation, form submission, or admitted navigation; the app owns handlers, commands, routes and authorization.
The component has no mount/unmount lifecycle or browser module; a server patch replaces presentation, not app behavior.
A visible nonblank label names the action; an icon is decorative.
Action buttons do not submit; submit buttons belong inside an admitted command form.
Links have safe destinations; disabled links have no href.
Busy controls show a replacement label, expose aria-busy, and cannot activate.
